hero.subtitle: Spin the wheel. Build crews. The shame table never forgets — whoever loses most often wears the crown.
hero.note: Free · Sign in with Google · Only your crew sees your shame

features.subtitle: Casino physics, crew system, stats. Everything your 5-friend gang needs to finally decide, fair and square, who pays.
features.physicsText: No pre-computed winner. The wheel spins with real angular velocity and friction and can stop anywhere — Vegas feeling.
features.crewsText: Create your gang in 5 seconds, share the 6-character code via WhatsApp. Multiple crews simultaneously — Slack-style switcher.
features.tableText: Each crew has its own table. Who loses how often? Weekly, monthly, yearly, all-time filters. Owner can reset — or not.
features.modesText: Classic: one spin, one shame. Elimination: each spin removes one, the last carries the shame. Both modes with full stats.
features.rivalsText: Bruno loses 8:3 to Lea. Head-to-head per pairing, plus losing streaks. Who's on the bad track?
features.nicksText: Owner assigns nicknames — Bruno Schmid becomes Bro, everywhere in the crew. History stays correct because we use user IDs internally.

howto.title: How it works
howto.step1Text: One click and you're in. We use Google OAuth.
howto.step2Text: You become owner and get a 6-character code. Share it with your gang.
howto.step3Text: Spins go into your shared shame table. Whoever loses wears it.

trust.privateText: Only invited crew members see the table.
trust.soundText: Mechanical ticks while spinning, jackpot on win.
trust.idleText: The wheel lives — it keeps spinning gently even without a game.

cta.subtitle: Sign in with Google. Create a crew. Share the code. 2 minutes and you're in.

login.title: Sign in
